title: Pada hai naher pa ghazi ka lasha
body:
pada hai nehr par ghazi ka lasha
<<DIVIDER>>
qayaam e shaah me hai shor barpa
<<MINI>>
pada hai nehr par ghazi ka lasha
<<DIVIDER>>
huwe bazu qalam jab bawafa ke
gire jalti zamee'n par fersh e zee'n se
hazaro tegh the saqqa tha tanha
hussain ibne ali lashe pe aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
khade rone lage wo sar jhukaye
badan zakhmo'n se hai majrooh sara
muhafiz ab nahi parde ka koi
har ek manzil qayamat ki ghadi thi
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi hai puchhne wala hamara
khade hain dar pe sab masoom bache
liye haatho'n me apne khaali kooze
sakina deti hai sab ko dilasa
<<DIVIDER>>
ye roke kehti hai bali sakina
chacha ajao ab mushkil hai jeena
bapa hai bibiyo'n me shore girya
hai khaak o khoo'n me humshakle payambar
<<DIVIDER>>
sada har baar ye dete the sarwar
koi imdaad ko a aye khudara
sakina ko laga jab bhi tamacha
tadap jata tha ek bimar bhayya
<<DIVIDER>>
sada de ab kise nanhi sakina
chale darbar me namoose sarwar
hai be parda nahi hai sar pe chadar
jhukaye sar khada hai sheh ka kunba
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e bazaar hai aale payambar
na qasim hai na hai shere dilawar
hal abid bekas o nachaar tanha
hai bibi aap se maruza itna
<<DIVIDER>>
ye saqqa e haram dete hain pursa
baraye nazr hai lab par ye nouha
kate shaane uthaye shaah jisdam
tha sarwar par sohail ek gham ka alam
<<DIVIDER>>
kamar thaame yahi kehte the moula
